articles.title: CNN, MS NOW, and Politico Sue Trump Over White House Press Ban
articles.summary: Three major news outlets are suing President Trump after he banned them from White House events. They say it violates the First Amendment. A federal judge will decide.

articles.title: Poland: Russian Military Helicopter Violated Our Airspace for 42 Seconds
articles.summary: Poland says a Russian Mi-8 helicopter entered its airspace for 42 seconds on Wednesday. NATO member Poland scrambled fighter jets. Russia has not commented.

articles.title: Harry Kane Eyes NFL Kicking Career After Soccer
articles.summary: England's all-time top scorer Harry Kane says he may become an NFL kicker after his soccer career. The 33-year-old Bayern Munich striker says penalty kicks and field goals require similar pressure and technique.
